source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Direct source review of all eighteen Upper Marina rows the v0.2 audit classified CONTEXT_ONLY. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only; source prose is not reproduced. Marina FloatHomes' rental role is also corroborated by the official Night City Atlas v1.01.

entities.name: Digital Divinity Incorporated, NC
entities.source_summary: Night City headquarters of Digital Divinity Incorporated, functioning as a high-security corporate church and meeting point for prominent adherents; no customer-facing paid commerce is stated.

entities.name: CMax
entities.source_summary: Former cinema used as the Prime-Time Players' headquarters and screening space; its lobby still contains themed food booths serving visitors.

local_offerings.label: Themed lobby food-booth meals and snacks

entities.catalogue_note: The source identifies prepared food booths rather than a repeatable grocery assortment.

entities.name: Court Towers
entities.source_summary: Former business center converted into expensive residential conapts; the source describes the housing complex but does not identify a public sales, rental, retail or service desk.

entities.name: Flowertown
entities.source_summary: Tent settlement occupying the remains of a former florist complex, organized by squatters, scavvers and the Street Queens; no source-supported customer commerce is described.

entities.name: The Garden of Earthly Delights
entities.source_summary: High-cost adult entertainment and bathhouse venue where wealthy patrons choose private experiences; meals are arranged through local restaurants and delivered to the site.

services.label: Restaurant meal ordering and delivery arrangement

entities.catalogue_note: Food and other consumables are ancillary to a service venue and are not modeled as a stable shelf assortment.

entities.name: Great River Storehouse
entities.source_summary: Physical fulfillment warehouse for Ziggurat's Great River shopping pilot, holding commercial goods and delivery drones for purchases placed through The Garden.

distribution.service_area: secure areas rated Security Code 6 or higher

entities.catalogue_note: The source confirms broad warehoused commercial goods but does not define a stable item list; this remains a fulfillment channel rather than generated local shelf stock.

entities.name: Hydrosubsidium R&D
entities.source_summary: Guarded research facility with private waterfront access and unexplained crate transfers to boats and helicopters; no public-facing sales or contracted service point is stated.

entities.name: JC Homes
entities.source_summary: Failed luxury-apartment project now occupied by squatters and Maelstrom; repeated attempts to auction the damaged property have produced no buyer and no active public commercial operation.

entities.name: La Lune Bleue
entities.source_summary: Exclusive French restaurant with strict prestige-based admission and freshly prepared meals; the source gives an average meal-for-two cost of 500eb.
entities.catalogue_note: Prepared restaurant meals are modeled as hospitality rather than grocery inventory.

entities.name: Marina Breeze Apartments
entities.source_summary: Low-cost apartment complex with attached docks; the source explicitly describes rents as affordable.

entities.name: Marina FloatHomes
entities.source_ref: Night City 2045 p. 73; Night City Atlas v1.01 p. 6
entities.source_summary: Mixed floating-housing development ranging from purpose-built homes to cheap seasonal cubes; the official atlas identifies the houseboats as rentals.

entities.name: Megabuilding H8 Construction Site
entities.source_summary: Active AllNations megabuilding construction site backed by Night Corp and Ziggurat; the source describes the project and workforce rather than a customer-facing outlet or service point.

entities.name: Night City Convention Center
entities.source_summary: Large convention and event complex with meeting rooms, halls, auditoriums, VIP lounges and exclusive-event spaces; it hosts recurring major conventions and private corporate functions.
entities.catalogue_note: The Firearms Show and other conventions are events hosted at the venue, not permanent retail departments.

entities.name: Oceanside Docks
entities.source_summary: Private marina used by personal and working watercraft; the source describes the occupants and vessels but does not establish a public docking, charter or sales operation at the location itself.

entities.name: Otter Docks Transfer Station
entities.source_summary: Material-transfer facility that sorts, packs and exports salvage and demolition output gathered from projects across Night City.

entities.name: REO Meatwagon
entities.source_summary: Base for REO Meatwagon's lower-cost ambulance operation, dispatching ground emergency vehicles to citizens without Trauma Team contracts while excluding combat zones and destinations outside the city.
entities.catalogue_note: The bunker contains an armory and repair workshops for REO operations, but these are internal infrastructure rather than customer stock.

entities.name: TravlStay CityCenter
entities.source_summary: Operating cube hotel near Totentanz, expanded into a neighboring tower and offering basic lodging with minimal security.

entities.name: Upper Marina Substation 2
entities.source_summary: Electrical substation surrounded by landscaped public green space used as a neighborhood park; no paid customer service or retail operation is described.
